topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: The flight's delay stretches on, a quiet testament to the unforeseen. I watch the minutes tick by on the clock, each one a reminder of what cannot be changed. Plans crumble, yet here we stand, almost at ease in the sprawling expanse of the terminal. The traveler, now a fellow observer of this pause in time, faces the reality of a missed event. There's a soft acceptance in the air, a mutual understanding that some outcomes are beyond reach. In this moment, the world outside seems distant, and the importance of what's been missed fades to a gentle hum. We are all, in our own ways, adapting to the new path laid before us.
